text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(My legs are still light. Faster.
The wind roars in my ears. Faster.
My heartbeat is deafening. Faster.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I'm sure that "right now" is when I can be the absolute fastest.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (And... my miracle probably ends right there.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That is why, it must be "now."
It has to be "now"—!!)

"The day of the Centaur Stakes.
...To be honest, my memory of how I even made it to Hanshin Racecourse was hazy."
Before I knew it, K.S. Miracle was already in the waiting room getting ready to race. With a calm, composed face... hiding her fatigue.

Overcome with my own helplessness, I clench my fists until they creak.
The girl I must protect more than anyone is taking step after step into the darkness right now, and yet...

Even though I knew, because it was I who had first pushed her forward as she took that step,
because it was these very hands of mine, I still couldn't say a thing—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
For always making you look so worried."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I swear, at the very least, I'll definitely bring back a victory.
